title: Homogeneity of the random-variable norm
statement: For any measure space $(\Omega,\mu)$, any real-valued function $X$ on $\Omega$, and any $c,q\in\mathbb R$, the real-valued random-variable norm satisfies $N_q(cX)=|c|N_q(X)$.
